Occurrences.Kwic: 臨安慈雲道清禪師臨安慈雲道清禪師嘗垂語四則：一曰箭鋒相拄底，應機乃絲毫無差，邊方人語不相諳，如何辨他子細？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). Exact headword utterer: Ciyun Daoqing. Ciyun Daoqing gives the first of four public test-questions: when arrowheads meet point to point, response differs by no hairsbreadth.
Source text (圓悟佛果禪師語錄). Exact headword utterer: Yuanwu Keqin. Yuanwu uses the phrase in his uninterrupted hall address.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雖建立不同，而會歸則一，莫不箭鋒相拄，鞭影齊施，接物利生，啟悟多矣。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (建中靖國續燈錄). Exact actor: the reviewed unnamed compiler. The continuation-record preface describes the old schools as meeting arrowhead to arrowhead.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The continuation-record preface describes the old schools as meeting arrowhead to arrowhead.

Occurrences.Kwic: 箭鋒相拄不相饒，四人共拈一隻盞。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (宗鑑法林). Exact headword utterer: Yuanwu Keqin. The clause is explicitly introduced by 昭覺勤云 and belongs to Yuanwu’s comment.
Source text (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). Exact headword utterer: Yuanwu Keqin. Yuanwu’s Blue Cliff commentary identifies arrowheads meeting as the Fayan house style.

Occurrences.Kwic: 三世諸佛、歷代祖師、天下老和尚盡在拄杖頭上放大光明，現權現實，現機現境，列五位君臣，開三玄宗要，機境相投，箭鋒相拄，一字三句同源，圓相境致殊別。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (列祖提綱錄). Exact headword utterer: Yuanwu Keqin. The preceding paragraph names Yuanwu; the immediately following ceremony address continues the same first-person record voice and contains the phrase.
Source text (禪宗頌古聯珠通集). Exact actor: the unnamed verse author. The verse author remains unnamed after the six-rung review.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The anthology prints a capping verse containing the phrase without a recoverable author label in the complete unit.

Senses.Explanation: Arrowheads meeting point to point is an image for two encounter turns matching with no gap between their active points. Commentators apply it to paired answers and exchanges, while contrasting cases expose when the apparent match misses.
